department: Department of Biomechanics / School of Health and Kinesiology

deadline.value: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis for Spring, Summer, and Fall 2027; January 31 is the priority deadline for full departmental assistantship consideration.
deadline.quote: Spring 2027, Summer 2027, and Fall 2027: Applications for this program are accepted on a rolling basis. All materials must be submitted prior to the beginning of the semester in which the student has elected to begin coursework. To receive full consideration for departmental assistantships, applications must be received by January 31st.

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required for admission to the Ph.D. in Biomechanics and Kinesiology.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer a requirement for admission.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology (none in Biomechanics or Biomedical Engineering).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants must contact a potential faculty advisor prior to applying and confirm mentorship and advisor willingness prior to admission.
supervisor.quote: Preliminary contact is made with a potential advisor prior to applying to the program. Prior to being admitted, a student must confirm mentorship with an advisor based on mutual interests and willingness of the advisor to take on the student.

funding.value: Competitive doctoral research assistantships (paid at the typical NIH standard, dependent on available faculty/grant funding; UNO GAs provide tuition waiver and subsidized health insurance; January 31 priority deadline).
funding.quote: The availability of doctoral research assistants is largely determined by available funding to support the position. | Research assistants are typically paid the National Institutes of Health standard.

also.quote: To receive full consideration for departmental assistantships, applications must be received by January 31st.
As a graduate assistant you will be considered a UNO employee with a tuition waiver, monthly salary, and subsidized health insurance.

entry_route.value: Requires a master's degree or at least 30 graduate credit hours in a related field with a minimum 3.2 graduate GPA (60-credit post-master's Ph.D.).
entry_route.quote: Master’s degree, or minimum of 30 graduate hours in a related field, e.g., health, physical therapy

notes: Joint Ph.D. between the Department of Biomechanics and the School of Health and Kinesiology; holds a STEM-designated CIP code. Offers concentrations in Biomechanics (Movement Biomechanics and Cardiovascular Biomechanics), Physiology of Exercise, Motor Development and Control, and Physical Activity. Requires 3 letters of recommendation, 500-word statement of purpose, CV, and writing sample.
name: Biomechanics and Kinesiology, Ph.D.
